data.title: Accident questionnaire from car insurer
data.summary: Beispiel Versicherung AG wrote on 6 May 2026 about a liability claim from the accident on 28 April 2026. You must return the completed questionnaire on how the accident happened within 10 working days of the letter date.
data.explanation: The other party in the accident has made claims against your car liability insurance. The insurer needs your account of what happened to decide who is at fault. Fill in the questionnaire (Fragebogen) and send it back by the deadline shown. Answer truthfully and completely. If the case is complicated or you are unsure how to answer, consider getting advice. Note that the letter text does not include the questionnaire itself, so check that you received it.
